title: HackerEarth: Monk and Power of Time
description: The Monk is tracking process execution. In one unit of time, either the front process executes if it matches `ideal_order` (and is removed), or it is rotated to the back of the queue. Return total time units required to finish all processes.
constraints:
1 <= len(calling_order) == len(ideal_order) <= 100
• Time: O(N^2) | Space: O(N)
starter_code:
def time_to_execute(calling_order: list[int], ideal_order: list[int]) -> int:
    pass
solution:
def time_to_execute(calling_order: list[int], ideal_order: list[int]) -> int:
    from collections import deque
    q = deque(calling_order)
    time = 0
    for ideal in ideal_order:
        while q[0] != ideal:
            q.rotate(-1)
            time += 1
        q.popleft()
        time += 1
    return time
explanation: Deque simulation rotates processes until front matches ideal target in O(N^2) time.
